typography.font_family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

accessibility_and_rtl.rtl_guidelines: Ensure full RTL compatibility for Arabic layout. Use React Native's directional properties like 'marginStart', 'marginEnd', 'paddingStart', 'paddingEnd' instead of 'marginLeft'/'marginRight'. Flex direction 'row' automatically flips in RTL, so structure items logically.
accessibility_and_rtl.data_testid: PRESERVE ALL existing data-testid attributes exactly as they are.

instructions_to_main_agent: Locate the Modal component inside AdvRolesManager.js.

Change the root style of the Modal content to use the 'modal_backdrop' layout (flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', backgroundColor: 'rgba(...)') to ensure it overlays the desktop screen properly and dims the background.
Wrap the modal's inner content in a View with the 'modal_card' layout (maxWidth: 800, width: '100%', borderRadius: 16, backgroundColor: '#FFF', shadow). This fixes the edge-to-edge full bleed issue.

Refactor the 'Role Name' and 'Description' inputs. Apply fixed standard heights (e.g., 48px for name, minHeight 100px for description) with clear borders and subtle border-radius to replace the current massive full-width boxes.
Redesign the permissions top bar (Search, Filters, Counter). Group them into a cohesive 'permissions_toolbar' layout (flexWrap, gap, subtle background like #F8FAFC with a border).
Style the quick filters as pill-shaped 'chips' (borderRadius: 9999). Add active/inactive states visually.
Style the 'Selected: X/Y' counter as a neat badge next to the filters.
Ensure the Save and Cancel buttons are anchored at the bottom inside a 'modal_footer' with a distinct background (e.g., #F8FAFC) and top border.
DO NOT modify the internal grid logic of AdvPermissionPicker; only integrate smoothly with its top bounding area.
Verify that no 'data-testid' is removed or renamed.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with hierarchy (use proper React Native elevation/shadows).
You MUST NOT center align text globally. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Ensure inputs and actionable items have clear boundaries and focus indicators.
Use logical spacing (multiples of 4 or 8) for padding and margins to maintain rhythm.
